commander.name: Agent Frank Horrigan
commander.oracle_text:
Trample
Agent Frank Horrigan has indestructible as long as it attacked this turn.
Whenever Agent Frank Horrigan enters or attacks, proliferate twice. (To proliferate, choose any number of permanents and/or players, then give each another counter of each kind already there.)

themes.name: Spontaneous Infection
themes.pitch: Poison shows up out of nowhere, and every Horrigan swing pushes the whole table two ticks closer to ten.

themes.name: Forced Evolution
themes.pitch: Dose the board with FEV: counters stack, double, and grow every time the big guy attacks.

themes.name: Time to Die
themes.pitch: Their creatures shrink one proliferate or -X/-X at a time, and every death feeds you.

themes.name: Impure Strain
themes.pitch: The Enclave wanted pure humans; you want a warband of mutants that all hit harder together.

themes.name: Enclave Super Soldier
themes.pitch: Suit up Horrigan with gear and pump, then swing indestructible and trampling through anyone who stands in the way.

themes.name: Vault of Loyalty
themes.pitch: Proliferate ticks your planeswalkers toward ultimates while Horrigan guards them by trampling anything that attacks.

themes.name: Wasteland Warband
themes.pitch: Rally a horde of Warriors and mutants whose attack triggers turn every assault into a proliferating rampage.
